_about: The asylum (I-589) cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter; the subject, enclosures and fee note are the application's. Mailed to the lockbox for the client's state on USCIS's I-589 chart (schemas/uscis_lockboxes_i589.json). Fees per Form G-1055 (10/01/26) and uscis.gov/i-589: no filing fee; the Pub. L. 119-21 asylum application fee ($100) by separate payment. None for Ms. L. Settlement Class members. The attorney approves this file before volume use.
re_lines: Application: I-589 Application for Asylum and for Withholding of Removal
intro: Please be advised that this law office has been retained to represent {name} with respect to {pron} immigration matters. {case_paragraph} In support of {pron} {noun}, we have provided the following documents:

forms.i589: Applicant’s I-589 - Application for Asylum and for Withholding of Removal (original, signed), with supplement sheets
forms.g28_i589: Applicant’s G-28 - Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative

documents: Copy of Applicant’s National Identity Document
Copy of Applicant’s Birth Certificate and Translation
Copy of the Marriage Certificate (spouse included in the application)
Declarations in Support of the Application
Copies of Applicant’s Immigration Court Documents
Payment of the Public Law 119-21 asylum application fee ({i589_pl}), separate from any filing fee
fees: There is no filing fee for Form I-589. As required by Public Law 119-21, the asylum application fee of {i589_pl} for the principal applicant is enclosed as a separate payment ({schedule}).

fees_when.fees: The applicant is a Ms. L. Settlement Class member: under the court order in Ms. L. v. ICE, 18-cv-00428 (S.D. Cal.), no Public Law 119-21 asylum fee is due, and none is enclosed.

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
I-589: the client signs and dates Part D (after the application was read to them in their language) and each supplement sheet; the attorney signs Part E. Parts F and G stay blank.
Enclose the Pub. L. 119-21 asylum fee as its own payment (unless a Ms. L. class member, then write "Ms. L Settlement Class Member" at the top of page 1).
Mail it with tracking, well before the 1-year deadline: the filing date is the day USCIS receives it.
